mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above the prior 12-month average signals stronger household demand, which raises earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that pressures firms to raise wages and prices, which erodes profit margins and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4% and continues for 3 months
failure_condition: If 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below the prior 12-month average signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO 3-month % change < 0 and below prior 12-month average
failure_condition: If 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in real retail sales (RSAFS) below the prior 12-month average signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces revenue growth and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS 6-month % change < 0 and below prior 12-month average
failure_condition: If 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary stance that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above the prior 12-month average signals labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS 3-month % change > 0 and above prior 12-month average
failure_condition: If 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) above the prior 12-month average signals stronger residential investment, which raises construction-related earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST 3-month % change > 0 and above prior 12-month average
failure_condition: If 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year window.
